name: Hyperspace
description: A space-opera set: a starfield that jumps to lightspeed while the agent works, a holographic conversation and a cockpit chat bar. Pick its parts, or the whole set, in Settings, Mods.
author: Silo Harness

looks.title: Holo terminal
looks.description: Transmission panels for your messages, instrument readouts for tool calls, code as instrument panels.

looks.title: Cockpit
looks.description: The chat bar as a console, with a status light while the agent works.

settings.title: Glow
settings.description: The colour of the streaks, the edges and the lights, in the conversation, the chat bar and the background.

settings.title: Motion
settings.description: Full jumps to lightspeed while the agent works; calm only speeds the stars up a little. With reduced motion turned on in the system everything holds still.
